findings.text: Replay “as today” cannot meet D9’s generated consumer-schema test because `Replay.databaseSqlWith` rejects triggers, indexes, CHECK constraints and foreign keys, while D6’s reified candidates lack original construction text. Fix: specify how generated candidates obtain construction SQL that passes exact reconstruction validation.

D5 assumes every step-2 counterexample has no smaller candidate, but D3 tries targeted two-row patterns before exhaustive one-row candidates. Fix: retain shrinking for targeted hits and skip it only when the search order establishes minimality.

D8 assumes heartbeats bound replay and text preparation, but D6 introduces compiled data computations that cannot be interrupted by that budget, and D2’s timed wait covers only screening. Fix: extend the timed, cancellation-aware execution boundary to compiled data evaluation.

The claim that `unknown` covers every database within the row bound contradicts D3’s uniform-row restriction and the candidate and time limits. Fix: describe a bounded search over the specified candidate subset that can stop before enumeration finishes.
